items.title: Create services from the current group
items.desc: Create a service directly from its group context without choosing the group again in the dialog.

items.title: Built-in and custom tags
items.desc: Use common language, framework and specification tags, or create custom tags with colors and marks.

items.title: Edit service details
items.desc: Edit a service name, description and tags from its context menu, with changes reflected immediately in the catalog and overview.

items.title: Make repository status visible
items.desc: The service overview shows a green success state, repository name and provider beside New specification.

items.title: Safely remove source bindings
items.desc: Unlink a service repository or specification source while preserving document content and restoring the appropriate editing actions.

items.title: Improve narrow-window layouts
items.desc: Dialogs, buttons and tag pills now share a consistent style without horizontal overflow in narrow service workflows.

items.title: Create, edit and preview Markdown specifications
items.desc: Create Markdown specifications under a service and maintain them with edit, split preview and preview-only modes.

items.title: Specification history and restore
items.desc: Keep revision history when saving specifications, inspect previous content and restore a revision into the current version.

items.title: Unsaved change protection and conflict feedback
items.desc: Protect unsaved content when leaving the editor and preserve the local draft when a save conflicts.

items.title: Markdown presentation details
items.desc: Improve headings, lists, quotes, tables, code blocks, task lists and reading layout on narrow windows.

items.title: Unified navigation and window controls
items.desc: The desktop app uses a borderless layout with theme, settings, minimize, maximize, fullscreen and close actions in one top navigation bar.

items.title: Bilingual UI and shortcut settings
items.desc: Switch between Simplified Chinese and English; search shortcuts by category, edit them, disable them or reset them.

items.title: Guided specification creation
items.desc: The new specification flow supports search, category filters, grid or list views, and type-specific multi-step creation.

items.title: Tooltips no longer block actions
items.desc: Tooltips appear below their buttons after a short delay, so settings, sign-out and sidebar controls remain clickable.

items.title: Creation feedback and migration protection
items.desc: Group and service creation now provide immediate state, idempotent retries and recovery; Web and desktop hosts keep business writes gated until migrations are ready.

items.title: Desktop application updates
items.desc: Manual checks, signed downloads and confirmed installation, with version information and bilingual release notes in About.

items.title: Tag-based releases
items.desc: A consistent application version and vX.Y.Z releases containing platform installers, updater metadata and bilingual release notes.
